🔧 Maintenance.description: Control app maintenance mode. Set maintenance_enabled to true to block all users.

maintenance_enabled.description: Set to true to show the maintenance screen to all users. Set back to false when done.

maintenance_title.description: Title shown on the maintenance popup.

defaultValue.value: We're doing some maintenance to improve Wudi for you. We'll be back online shortly!

maintenance_message.description: Body message shown on the maintenance popup.

maintenance_estimated_end.description: Estimated time maintenance will end (e.g. '3:00 PM UTC'). Leave empty to hide.

🚀 App Update.description: Control app update prompts. Use force_update_enabled + min_version for required updates, or just latest_version for optional prompts.

force_update_enabled.description: Set to true to force users below min_version to update before using the app.

min_version.description: Minimum required app version (semver x.y.z). Users below this AND force_update_enabled=true will be forced to update.

latest_version.description: Latest available version (semver x.y.z). Users below this (but above min_version) will see an optional update prompt.

update_url_android.description: Direct APK download URL or Google Play Store URL for Android. Leave empty to disable the Update Now button.

update_title.description: Title shown on the update popup.

defaultValue.value: A new version of Wudi is ready! Update now to get the latest features and improvements.

update_message.description: Body message shown on the update popup.

update_changelog.description: Optional changelog / release notes shown in the update popup (e.g. '• Bug fixes\n• Performance improvements'). Leave empty to hide.
